Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3305); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine:--Joppa.
BiblicalUsage: Joppa was the seaport where Peter raised Tabitha and learned the gospel was for the Gentiles. In Acts 9:36 Tabitha, full of good works, dies at Joppa, in Acts 10:5 the angel tells Cornelius to send to Joppa and call for Simon Peter, and in Acts 9:43 Peter tarries many days in Joppa with Simon the tanner.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Joppa is where the church turned a corner: a disciple raised from the dead, and a vision on a rooftop that opened the door to the nations.
